name: C# and .NET
certifications: Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400) as a next step

beginner.summary: For new developers and those moving to C# from other languages. Covers the .NET platform, C# syntax, types, control flow, methods, object-oriented programming, collections and LINQ, exceptions, files, async basics, unit testing and a first ASP.NET Core API with Entity Framework Core.
prerequisites: Comfortable with computers and installing software
Basic logical thinking; earlier programming helps
outcomes: Write C# programs with classes, interfaces and collections
Query data with LINQ and handle errors
Build a simple ASP.NET Core Web API backed by a database

subtopics: What .NET is: runtime, SDK and libraries
Visual Studio and VS Code with C# Dev Kit
days.lab_task: Install the SDK, create a solution with a console app and a class library, reference one from the other, add a NuGet package and print a formatted receipt.
checks: Package referenced in the csproj and used

subtopics: int, decimal, double, bool, char, string
days.lab_task: Write a loan calculator that reads amounts from the console, parses them safely, uses decimal for money and prints a formatted schedule.
checks: decimal is exact, double is not

subtopics: Pattern matching: type, property and relational patterns
for, foreach, while and do loops
days.lab_task: Write a shipping calculator that uses switch expressions with relational and property patterns for weight and destination, and loops over a list of parcels.
checks: Uses patterns instead of nested ifs

days.lab_task: Refactor the calculator into small methods returning tuples, model a parcel as a record and show value equality and with expressions.
checks: New record with one changed property

days.lab_task: Model a library with Book and Member classes, properties with validation and constructors, and a static counter, then print a report.
checks: Create a book with an empty title
Set a private field from outside

days.lab_task: Build a payroll system with an abstract Employee, salaried and hourly subclasses, an IPayable interface also implemented by invoices, and process all items in one loop.
checks: Each pay amount follows its rule
No change to the processing loop

days.lab_task: Count word frequency in a text file with a Dictionary, find unique words with a HashSet and write a generic Repository<T> with add, find and list.
checks: Top ten match the answer file
Add a Member to a Repository<Book>
Look up a missing key with TryGetValue

days.lab_task: Load sales data into objects and use LINQ to find revenue by region, top products, monthly totals and customers with no orders.
Add a bank account class that throws a custom InsufficientFundsException, a transfer method that never loses money and file reading that disposes resources.
days.deliverable: Source and output for success and failure cases
checks: Clear message and file handle released
Exception filter catches only the intended case

days.lab_task: Read orders from JSON, validate them, write a CSV report and read settings from appsettings.json with an environment variable override.
checks: Override a setting with an environment variable

days.topic: Asynchronous Programming with async and await
subtopics: Running tasks in parallel with Task.WhenAll
days.lab_task: Call a weather API for five cities in parallel with HttpClient, cancel after a timeout and handle a failed city without losing the others.
checks: Faster than one at a time

days.lab_task: Write unit tests for the bank account and payroll code with theories, exception tests and a mocked repository, and measure coverage.
checks: At least 80 percent of the domain code

subtopics: Visual Studio and VS Code debugger
days.lab_task: Find five planted bugs with the debugger, turn on nullable reference types and fix the warnings, and apply a shared code style.
checks: Stops only on the failing record

days.topic: Your First ASP.NET Core Web API
subtopics: Running and testing with HTTP files
days.lab_task: Build a products Web API with list, get, create, update and delete endpoints, correct status codes and Swagger documentation.
checks: Create a product with a missing name

days.topic: Entity Framework Core and SQL Server
days.lab_task: Store products and categories with EF Core, create migrations, query with LINQ including related data and inspect the generated SQL.
checks: Related data loaded in one query
Add a column with a migration

days.topic: Validation, Errors and Logging in APIs
days.lab_task: Add FluentValidation, a global exception handler returning problem details and Serilog structured logging with request IDs to the API.
checks: 500 with problem details and no stack trace in the response
Each request logged with an ID

days.topic: Authentication with ASP.NET Core Identity and JWT
days.lab_task: Add registration and login with Identity, issue JWTs, protect create and delete endpoints by role and test access for anonymous, user and admin.

days.topic: Building a Simple Web UI with Razor Pages or Blazor
days.lab_task: Build a Blazor or Razor Pages front end that lists products from the API, shows details and has a validated create form for admins.
checks: Open the admin form as a normal user

days.lab_task: Publish the API as a Docker image with health checks, deploy it to Azure App Service with production settings and view the logs.
days.deliverable: Dockerfile, live URL and log screenshot
checks: API answers on the mapped port

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Library Management Web API
days.lab_task: Build a library API for books, members and loans with borrowing rules, fines, EF Core storage, validation, JWT security, unit tests and logging, deploy it and demo it.
days.deliverable: Repository, test report, live URL and a 10-minute demo
checks: Borrow a book that is already on loan
Rejected with a clear problem details error
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one API

intermediate.summary: For C# developers who have built simple apps. Covers modern C# features, clean architecture, advanced ASP.NET Core, EF Core in depth, caching, background services, messaging, gRPC and SignalR, testing at every level, performance, security, Azure services and CI/CD.
prerequisites: Writes C# with classes, interfaces, LINQ and async
Has built an ASP.NET Core API with EF Core
outcomes: Build robust APIs with EF Core, caching, messaging and real-time features

days.topic: Modern C# Features from C# 9 to 12
days.lab_task: Modernise a provided C# 7 codebase with records, required members, pattern matching, collection expressions and primary constructors, keeping all tests passing.
checks: Create an object without a required member

subtopics: Repository and unit of work debate
days.lab_task: Restructure the library API into clean architecture with MediatR commands and queries, value objects for money and email, and architecture tests that enforce layers.
checks: Create a member with an invalid email

days.topic: Dependency Injection and the Options Pattern
subtopics: Secrets in development with user secrets
days.lab_task: Register services with correct lifetimes, bind and validate typed options at start-up, use keyed services for two payment providers and fix a captive dependency bug.
checks: App fails at start with a clear message
Scoped service no longer held by a singleton

days.topic: Advanced ASP.NET Core: Middleware, Filters and Versioning
days.lab_task: Add custom request timing middleware, API versioning with v1 and v2, rate limiting per client, output caching and health checks for the database.
Configure the model with Fluent API and owned types, fix an N+1 query, add optimistic concurrency and compare a heavy report query in EF Core and Dapper.
days.deliverable: Model configuration, SQL logs and comparison
checks: Load orders with lines before and after the fix
Update the same row from two contexts
Second save throws a concurrency exception

days.lab_task: Cache product lists in Redis with invalidation on updates, protect against a cache stampede and load-test before and after.
days.deliverable: Caching code and load test results
checks: Only one database query fills it

days.lab_task: Add a background service that sends overdue loan reminders nightly with Hangfire, retries failures and stops cleanly on shutdown.
checks: Make the email service fail once
Stop the app during a job
Job finishes or is resumed cleanly

days.topic: Messaging with RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus and MassTransit
days.lab_task: Publish a loan-created event with MassTransit and the outbox pattern, consume it in a notification service idempotently and route failures to a dead-letter queue.
checks: Moved to the dead-letter queue after retries
Message still sent from the outbox

subtopics: Scaling SignalR with Azure SignalR Service
days.lab_task: Add a gRPC inventory service with server streaming and a SignalR hub that pushes loan status changes to connected browsers.
days.deliverable: gRPC service, SignalR hub and demo

days.topic: Integration Testing with WebApplicationFactory and Testcontainers
days.lab_task: Write integration tests for the API against a real SQL Server container, with test authentication and database resets between tests.
checks: Call a protected endpoint in a test

days.lab_task: Benchmark and optimise a CSV parsing hot path with Span<T>, cut allocations, profile the API under load and fix the top CPU hot spot.
Find and fix five planted vulnerabilities, move secrets to Key Vault, configure CORS and security headers and scan dependencies.
checks: Try SQL injection through a raw query

days.topic: Authentication with OpenID Connect and Microsoft Entra ID
days.lab_task: Protect the API with Entra ID, require scopes for read and write, use app roles for admins and call a downstream API on behalf of the user.
days.deliverable: App registrations, API configuration and tests
checks: Call write endpoints with a read-only token
Call as an admin app role
Token passed on behalf of the user

days.lab_task: Deploy the API to App Service with Azure SQL and Storage using managed identity, add an Azure Function triggered by Service Bus and monitor with Application Insights.

subtopics: Docker Compose for API, database and Redis
days.lab_task: Build small images for the API and worker, run them with SQL Server and Redis in Compose, and scan the images.
days.deliverable: Images, Compose file and scan report

days.topic: CI/CD with GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps
days.lab_task: Build a pipeline that tests with coverage, applies EF Core migrations and deploys to staging and production slots with approval and slot swap.

subtopics: Exporting to Application Insights or Grafana
days.lab_task: Instrument the API, worker and notification service with OpenTelemetry, follow one loan through all three in traces and add a custom metric with an alert.
Move the solution to .NET Aspire with an app host, service defaults, Redis, SQL Server and RabbitMQ, run it locally and deploy to Azure Container Apps.
checks: All services start with the dashboard

days.lab_task: Build a Blazor admin app with interactive server and WebAssembly components, Entra ID sign-in, validated forms and bUnit tests.
checks: Admin pages shown only to admins

subtopics: API with EF Core, caching and messaging
days.lab_task: Deliver a library platform with clean architecture, cached API, messaging, SignalR notifications, background jobs, Entra ID, integration tests, OpenTelemetry and CI/CD to Azure, then present it.
days.deliverable: Repository, pipeline, Azure deployment, dashboards and a 15-minute demo
checks: Tests pass and the app deploys
Event, notification and trace all visible
Call write endpoints without the scope
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one platform

advanced.summary: For senior .NET developers and architects. Covers runtime internals and performance, advanced async and concurrency, domain-driven design, microservices and event-driven systems on .NET, high-performance APIs, data at scale, distributed system resilience, security architecture, Azure architecture, modernising .NET Framework apps and technical leadership.
prerequisites: Knows EF Core, messaging, testing and Azure
outcomes: Build resilient, secure services on Azure at scale

days.topic: .NET Runtime Internals: CLR, JIT and Garbage Collection
days.lab_task: Inspect IL for a hot method, compare start-up with ReadyToRun and Native AOT, analyse a memory dump from a leaking service and tune GC settings.
days.deliverable: IL notes, start-up comparison, dump analysis and GC settings

days.lab_task: Rewrite a log parser with Pipelines, Span and ArrayPool to reach zero allocations per line, and use a source generator to replace reflection-based mapping.
checks: Replace reflection with a source generator

subtopics: Task internals and the thread pool
days.lab_task: Build a producer-consumer pipeline with Channels and bounded capacity, fix a thread pool starvation incident and a sync-over-async deadlock.
days.deliverable: Pipeline code, incident fixes and counters
checks: Run the pipeline at high load
Thread pool queue length returns to normal

subtopics: Strategic design: bounded contexts and context maps
days.lab_task: Run an event storming session for an insurance claims domain, define bounded contexts and build the Claim aggregate with invariants and domain events in .NET.
days.deliverable: Event storming board, context map and aggregate code with tests

days.lab_task: Split the claims system into claims, payments and documents services behind YARP, coordinate claim payment with a MassTransit saga and handle a payment failure.
checks: Saga compensates and the claim returns to review
Each path reaches the right service

subtopics: Event sourcing with Marten or EventStoreDB
days.lab_task: Event-source the Claim aggregate, build projections for a claims dashboard, version an event and rebuild projections from scratch.

days.topic: High-Performance APIs and Minimal APIs at Scale
days.lab_task: Build a Native AOT minimal API with JSON source generation, tune Kestrel, load-test it and compare throughput and memory with the JIT version.
days.deliverable: API, load test results and comparison
checks: Instance counts for the target load

days.topic: Data at Scale with SQL Server and Azure SQL
days.lab_task: Tune the slowest queries from Query Store, route reads to a replica, use temporal tables for claim history, run a zero-downtime migration and model one service in Cosmos DB.
days.deliverable: Tuning results, configuration and migration log

days.topic: Resilience with Polly and Distributed Systems Patterns
days.lab_task: Add resilience pipelines to service calls, inject faults with Simmy, verify the circuit breaker and fallback behaviour and make payment requests idempotent.
days.deliverable: Resilience configuration and chaos test results
checks: Calls time out and fall back

days.lab_task: Threat-model the claims platform, remove every stored secret with managed identities, encrypt sensitive fields, enable NuGet auditing and act on Defender recommendations.
days.deliverable: Threat model, configuration and findings record
checks: Read an encrypted field from the database directly

subtopics: Choosing compute: App Service, Container Apps, AKS, Functions
days.lab_task: Design and deploy the claims platform across two Azure regions with Front Door, private endpoints and Container Apps using Bicep, and review it against the Well-Architected Framework.
checks: Front Door sends traffic to the other
Reach the database from the internet

days.lab_task: Deploy the services to AKS with probes, workload identity and KEDA autoscaling on queue length, roll out a new version under load and fix a crash loop.
days.deliverable: Charts, autoscaling evidence and incident notes

days.lab_task: Add contract tests between claims and payments, mutation-test the domain to 80 percent, snapshot-test API responses and add architecture tests.

subtopics: Moving from Web Forms and MVC 5
Running old and new side by side
days.lab_task: Upgrade a provided .NET Framework MVC app with a WCF service, move two pages behind YARP to ASP.NET Core and replace the WCF service with gRPC.
days.deliverable: Assessment, migrated parts and progress report
checks: Same behaviour from the new app

days.topic: Observability and Incident Response at Scale
days.lab_task: Set SLOs with burn-rate alerts, then handle three injected incidents (a slow database call, a memory leak and a thread pool starvation), and write runbooks.
checks: Leaking type found in a dump

days.lab_task: Add a claims assistant that answers from policy documents with Azure AI Search, calls a claim lookup function, logs cost and is evaluated on 20 questions.
days.deliverable: AI feature, evaluation and cost note
checks: Lookup function called with the right ID

subtopics: Packaging for Android, iOS and Windows
days.lab_task: Build a .NET MAUI claims app for Android and Windows that signs in with Entra ID, lists claims offline from SQLite, syncs when online and receives a push notification.
Package shared service defaults as a NuGet library with source link, write a Roslyn analyser that flags a banned API, publish a dotnet new template and document it.
checks: Analyser warning shown with a code fix
Create a project from the template

days.lab_task: Write a .NET upgrade and standards plan for a team with ten services, rank technical debt by impact and mentor a junior developer through a review.
days.deliverable: Plan, debt register and mentoring notes
checks: Each service has a target version and order

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Event-Driven Claims Platform on Azure
subtopics: High-performance APIs and data at scale
days.lab_task: Deliver a claims platform with DDD services, event sourcing, sagas, resilience, managed identities, multi-region AKS deployment, SLO monitoring and an AI assistant, then load-test, fail over and present it.
days.deliverable: Repositories, deployment, load and failover reports and a 20-minute presentation
checks: Fail over a region under load
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one platform
